title: MessageStrip
description: Fiori message strip: information/positive/negative/critical and color-set designs, closable.

usage.summary: Explain application messages in context within a page or section.
useWhen: Keep users informed about a warning, status change or guidance that applies to the current page or section.
Place the message close to the affected content so users can keep working and understand its scope.
Use design for message severity; handle onClose in the application when users may dismiss the strip.

avoidWhen.when: Confirm a completed action briefly without requiring a response.
An empty or unavailable area needs an illustration and a recovery or next-step action.
Require an explicit response. Use MessageBox for standard actions, or Dialog for a custom workflow.
Show the state of an individual object inside a table cell or list item.
